description: Your saved audience segments (named filters such as "Influencers" or "Switch prospects"), each with the number of people in it right now, plus presets you can save with create_segment. Pass a segment id to list_people to see its members. With groupId, the segments saved in that keyword group, counted over its own people.

groupId.description: Scope to one keyword group (grp_...): only people who mentioned that group's keywords, with that group's own tags, notes, mute, merges, activities and segments. Omit for the whole workspace.

name: list_segments
title: List segments
